sentences.text:
Dated this the 11th day of December, 2024 The petitioner is the 6th accused in Crime No. 1024/2014 registered at Guruvayoor Police Station for the offence punishable under Section 420 r/w 34 of IPC,
now pending as CC No.2383/2014 on the files of the Judicial First Class Magistrate Court,
Chavakkad.

entities.text:
Judicial First Class Magistrate Court,
Chavakkad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
The petitioner was granted bail by the trial court, but failed to appear thereafter,
resulting in cancellation of the bail and issuance of non- bailable warrant.
2. Learned Counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is seeking only an opportunity to surrender and move an application for bail before the trial court.
3. I heard the learned Public Prosecutor CRL.MC NO. 10196 OF 2024 2024:KER:95305 also.

Considering the limited relief sought, the Crl.MC is disposed of as under;
i) The petitioner shall surrender before the Court below within two weeks, with advance notice to the Public Prosecutor.
ii) If petitioner surrenders within the time granted, orders on her bail application shall be passed on the date of surrender itself.
iii) Execution of the non-bailable warrant pending against the petitioner shall be kept in abeyance for two weeks.

Sd/-
